definitions.explanation: Coverings for the hands with separate sections for fingers. Literally 'hand bag/cover.'

examples.english: The type of gloves you can use a smartphone with while wearing them is convenient.

notes:
{手袋|てぶくろ} literally means "hand bag" ({手|て} + {袋|ふくろ}), referring to coverings for hands with separate finger sections.

VERBS FOR WEARING:
- {手袋|てぶくろ}をする: to wear gloves (general)
- {手袋|てぶくろ}をはめる: to put on gloves (specific action)
- {手袋|てぶくろ}を{外|はず}す: to take off gloves

TYPES:
- {革|かわ}の{手袋|てぶくろ}: leather gloves
- {毛糸|けいと}の{手袋|てぶくろ}: knit gloves
- ゴム{手袋|てぶくろ}: rubber gloves
- ミトン: mittens (fingerless type)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {手袋|てぶくろ}を{片方|かたほう}なくす: to lose one glove
- {手袋|てぶくろ}をしたまま: while wearing gloves

NOTE:
Modern touchscreen-compatible gloves are called タッチパネル{対応|たいおう}{手袋|てぶくろ}.
